notes: Freedom Australia (SAP Commerce/Hybris + Spartacus Angular SPA; product data client-rendered via a Coveo headless commerce widget). Checked categorysitemap.xml (235 URLs) and main nav for New Arrivals / New In / Just Arrived / Latest terms: exactly one match, /c/new-arrivals, a single undifferentiated top-level listing (no 'Furniture New Arrivals' / 'Lighting New Arrivals' style children exist in the sitemap or nav) - a single row is emitted. Direct HTTP fetch confirmed 200 status with SSR title 'New Freedom Homeware Arrivals in Australia | Freedom' but, as with Bestsellers, no product count in the SSR shell. On Playwright/CDP render this page was notably slower to hydrate than the other two concepts (first two render attempts, at 9s and then a selector-wait strategy, both caught the page still showing a bare 'Loading...' placeholder with no product grid); a longer fixed-wait pass allowed the Coveo widget to finish and both the rendered page text ('2712 PRODUCTS' in the filter bar) and the intercepted Coveo commerce/v2/listing API response (pagination.totalProducts=2712) agreed exactly. This is a genuine PLP (browsable products, filters for Product Type/Price/Brand/Size/Colour/Features/Dimensions/Rating/Material, sort control) representing the site's catalogue-wide 'recently added' listing, not a themed campaign or lookbook - it sits directly in the main nav alongside the category verticals. The large count (2712, against a site-wide catalog of roughly 94k SKUs per the prior Home-Decor pass) is plausible for a broad multi-category home retailer's 'new' window and is the site's own exact reported number, not an estimate. No need for Claude-in-Chrome (tier 3).

rows.evidence: Rendered page text '2712 PRODUCTS' in the filter/sort bar; corroborated by Coveo commerce/v2/listing API JSON response field pagination.totalProducts = 2712
